sections.Overview: To celebrate the formation of “Troupe LeVoltaire” in 1772, the fully reimagined Cirqus Voltaire ™ Ringmaster Edition Pinball Machine is limited to 772 units ever produced. This edition features a new art package, interactive topper experience, and over $4,000 in upgrade value, making this a Cirqus experience that must be seen to truly be appreciated. Read on to learn more about the Ringmaster Edition and the Classic Edition, both featuring numerous modern upgrades.
sections.Features:
- New Artwork (Cabinet, Playfield, Plastics, Decals, etc.)​
- New Backbox Artwork, Decals, and Plastics
- Holographic Edition Number (Limited to 772 Units) on Custom Magnetic Apron​
- Sparkle Illusion Purple Powder Coat (Trim, Armor, Hinges, Apron, Coin Door, All Wireforms)​
- Play the Classic Rules or New Rules (Both Featuring Modern 3D Animated Visuals)​
- Full RGB Insert & General Illumination Lighting​
- Interactive RGB Neon Bar Lighting + Matching Interactive RGB Mini-Playfield Lighting​
- Wonder Rails of Light™ Interactive Armor Lighting​
- New Cannon Bell (Illusion Purple Powder Coat)​
- Interior Art Blades + Art Blade Protectors​
- 6 Hand-Painted Sculpts: 2x Slings, 2x Outlanes, Shooter Rod, ARTlock™
- Premium Speakers, Remastered Audio & Callouts​
- Original Artwork (Cabinet, Playfield, etc.)
- New Cannon Bell (Polished Silver Finish)
- Premium Speakers, Remastered Audio & Callouts
- Topper ($1,099) and Scrolls ($649) Upgrade Available​
sections.Classic Edition Add-Ons: These add ons are included with the Ringmaster Edition and available as add-ons for the Classic Edition.

sections.Frequently Asked Questions:
When was the Barry O's BBQ Challenge pinball machine released? Barry O’s BBQ Challenge was released by American Pinball in June 2024. What is Barry O's BBQ Challenge Pinball? Barry Oursler’s final all-new design, commemorating his illustrious 46-year career in game design. In honor of Barry, we’re excited to introduce ‘Barry O’s BBQ Challenge’ – a pinball adventure that captures the essence of summer fun and embodies the spirit of neighborhood BBQ Festivals across America. Available in two delectable editions – Limited and Classic – each game is seasoned to perfection, ready to become the centerpiece of your collection. Is the Oktoberfest pinball still in production? Barry O’s BBQ Challenge is not in production anymore. To get game support, contact us.
